messages.subject: Help with Environ output
parts:
Dear Mike,
I am using the microclimate and ectotherm models of NicheMapR to model environmental temperatures of mosquitoes across a wide distribution range. The models are written within a loop and the ectotherm model is repeated to estimate temperatures with and without behavior as well as for different confidence intervals of the thermal limits. However, once the model runs and produces output in the environ data table, the TC values don't make sense(except for the body temperature output of the first ectotherm model). Sometimes the lower estimate is higher than the upper estimate or the modeled temperature with behavior is higher than that without behavior(which could be true in some cases assuming the code is working) and in other instances, the values repeat across all conditions despite having different input in the model. I'm wondering if I'm correctly applying the models here (maybe the code is incorrect and the values are being written over) or if the output looks right. I have attached my script and a sample of the environ output (combined from running the ectotherm model under different conditions) as well as the final data set we would get. Let me know if I can clarify anything. I would be grateful for your insight. Thank you.

Code:
library(mcera5)
library(sf)
library(ecmwfr)
library(NicheMapR)
library(dplyr)
library(ncdf4)
library(curl)
library(keyring)
library(abind)
library(lubridate)
library(tidync)

cxp = read.csv("~/Documents/Thermal Adaptation Project 2.0/VectorOccurence/CulexPipiens.csv")
cxp = cxp[!is.na(cxp$decimalLatitude),]
cxp = cxp[!is.na(cxp$decimalLongitude),]

# # remove any duplicates (occurrences from same lat, lon)
cxp = cxp %>% dplyr::distinct(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, .keep_all = TRUE)
#
# # Latitudinal range: -39 to 67
cxp = subset(cxp, decimalLatitude>=30 & decimalLatitude<=40)
#
# # take random sample of 20-30 rows
cxp = sample_n(cxp, 10)

for (i in 1:nrow(cxp)){
 lat = cxp$decimalLatitude[i]
  lon = cxp$decimalLongitude[i]
  species = "Culex_pipiens"
 
  loc = c(lon, lat)
  dstart <- "01/01/2017"
  dfinish <- "31/12/2017"
  micro<-micro_era5(loc = loc, spatial = 'era5', Usrhyt = 1,
                    dstart = dstart, dfinish = dfinish,
                    minshade = 0, maxshade = 100)
  metout<-as.data.frame(micro$metout) # above ground microclimatic conditions, min shade
  shadeout = as.data.frame(micro$shadmet) # above ground microclimatic conditions, full shade
  tzone<-paste("Etc/GMT+",0,sep="") # append dates
  dates<-seq(as.POSIXct(dstart, format="%d/%m/%Y",tz=tzone)-3600*12, as.POSIXct(dfinish, format="%d/%m/%Y",tz=tzone)+3600*11, by="hours")
  met <- cbind(dates,metout)
  shade <- cbind(dates,shadeout)
 
  # Ectotherm model
  limitsdata = read.csv("~/Documents/Thermal Adaptation Project 2.0/thermal_limits.csv")
  speciesdata = limitsdata[limitsdata$species == species,]
  Trait = "larval_survival"
  traitdata = speciesdata[speciesdata$Trait == Trait,]  
 
  CTmax_point = traitdata$CTmax_point
  CTmax_lower = traitdata$CTmax_lower
  CTmax_upper = traitdata$CTmax_upper
 
  Topt_point = traitdata$Topt_point
  Topt_lower = traitdata$Topt_lower
  Topt_upper = traitdata$Topt_upper
 
  CTmin_point = traitdata$CTmin_point
  CTmin_lower = traitdata$CTmin_lower
  CTmin_upper = traitdata$CTmin_upper
 
  MosqTempPoint = ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                            T_pref = Topt_point, CT_max = CTmax_point, CT_min = CTmin_point,
                            diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                            shade_seek = 1, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  MosqTempPoint_NoB = ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                                T_pref = Topt_point, CT_max = CTmax_point, CT_min = CTmin_point,
                                diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                                shade_seek = 0, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  MosqTempLower= ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                           T_pref = Topt_lower, CT_max = CTmax_lower, CT_min = CTmin_lower,
                           diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                           shade_seek = 1, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  MosqTempLower_NoB = ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                                T_pref = Topt_lower, CT_max = CTmax_lower, CT_min = CTmin_lower,
                                diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                                shade_seek = 0, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  MosqTempUpper = ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                            T_pref = Topt_upper, CT_max = CTmax_upper, CT_min = CTmin_upper,
                            diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                            shade_seek = 1, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  MosqTempUpper_NoB = ectotherm(Ww_g = 0.003, shape = 2, alpha_min = 0.85, alpha_max = 0.85,
                                T_pref = Topt_lower, CT_max = CTmax_lower, CT_min = CTmin_lower,
                                diurn = 0, nocturn = 1, crepus = 1,
                                shade_seek = 0, burrow = 0, climb = 0)
 
  point = as.data.frame(MosqTempPoint$environ)
  lower = as.data.frame(MosqTempLower$environ)
  upper = as.data.frame(MosqTempUpper$environ)
 
  point_noB = as.data.frame(MosqTempPoint_NoB$environ)
  lower_noB = as.data.frame(MosqTempLower_NoB$environ)
  upper_noB = as.data.frame(MosqTempUpper_NoB$environ)
 
  ModeledTemps = cbind.data.frame(point, lower$TC, upper$TC,  point_noB$TC, lower_noB$TC, upper_noB$TC, met$TALOC, shade$TALOC)
  colnames(ModeledTemps)[c(5,30:36)] = c("Mosq_Temp_Point", "Mosq_Temp_Lower", "Mosq_Temp_Upper",
                                         "Mosq_Temp_NoB_Point", "Mosq_Temp_NoB_Lower", "Mosq_Temp_NoB_Upper",
                                         "Sun_Temp", "Shade_Temp")
 
  # Maximum body temperature
  maxtemp_point = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Point)
  maxtemp_lower = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Lower)
  maxtemp_upper = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Upper)
 
  maxtemp_NoB_point = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Point)
  maxtemp_NoB_lower = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Lower)
  maxtemp_NoB_upper = max(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Upper)
 
  # Thermal safety margin
  diff_point = Topt_point - maxtemp_point
  diff_lower = Topt_lower - maxtemp_lower
  diff_upper = Topt_upper - maxtemp_upper
 
  diff_NoB_point = Topt_point - maxtemp_NoB_point
  diff_NoB_lower = Topt_lower - maxtemp_NoB_lower
  diff_NoB_upper = Topt_upper - maxtemp_NoB_upper

  numhours_point = sum(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Point > Topt_point)

  numhours_upper = sum(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Upper > Topt_upper)
 
  numhours_NoB_point = sum(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Point > Topt_point)
  numhours_NoB_lower = sum(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Lower > Topt_lower)
  numhours_NoB_upper = sum(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Upper > Topt_upper)

  streak_point = as.numeric(tapply(runs_point$lengths, runs_point$values, max))[2]
  streak_lower = as.numeric(tapply(runs_lower$lengths, runs_lower$values, max))[2]
  streak_upper = as.numeric(tapply(runs_upper$lengths, runs_upper$values, max))[2]
 
  runs_NoB_point = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Point > Topt_point)
  runs_NoB_lower = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Lower > Topt_lower)
  runs_NoB_upper = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Upper > Topt_upper)
  streak_NoB_point = as.numeric(tapply(runs_NoB_point$lengths, runs_NoB_point$values, max))[2]
  streak_NoB_lower = as.numeric(tapply(runs_NoB_lower$lengths, runs_NoB_lower$values, max))[2]
  streak_NoB_upper = as.numeric(tapply(runs_NoB_upper$lengths, runs_NoB_upper$values, max))[2]
 
  df1[i,] = c(species, Trait, lat, lon, maxtemp_point, maxtemp_lower, maxtemp_upper,
              maxtemp_NoB_point, maxtemp_NoB_lower, maxtemp_NoB_upper,
              diff_point, diff_lower, diff_upper,
              diff_NoB_point, diff_NoB_lower, diff_NoB_upper,
              numhours_point, numhours_lower, numhours_upper,
              numhours_NoB_point, numhours_NoB_lower, numhours_NoB_upper,
              streak_point, streak_lower, streak_upper,
              streak_NoB_point, streak_NoB_lower, streak_NoB_upper,
              streak_dangerdays_point, streak_dangerdays_lower, streak_dangerdays_upper,
              streak_dangerdays_nob_point, streak_dangerdays_nob_lower, streak_dangerdays_nob_upper)
}
  
Best regards,
Desire

messages.subject: Re: Help with Environ output
parts:
Dear Desire,
I just had a quick look (but didn't try running any code) and I think the first thing to try is to specify T_RB_min, T_B_min and T_F_min to be the same as your CT_min and T_F_max to be the same as your CT_max. The CT_min and CT_max parameters are mainly affecting the model by pushing them deeper underground (or to climb) to avoid getting extremely hot. Actually, it tries to make them avoid hitting the half-way point between the CT_min and T_F_min and between T_F_max and CT_max. The activity is regulated around the T_F_min and T_F_max values (and note that they will become active if their body temperature in their retreat is below T_RB_min). 

Note also that in this case the main value of the ectotherm model for your mosquitoes is that it is simulating the behaviour, and not so much that it is calculating body temperature. You could assume their Tb is equal to the air temp (TALOC - which of course may not be the same as the reference/weather station air temp) because their body mass is so small that they are almost fully coupled to the air temperature. In fact you could avoid using the ectotherm model at all and just write your own code to determine where they'd be based on the output from the microclimate model. I think that might be the better way to go in your case. Make sense?

All the best,
Mike

  ModeledTemps$danger_upper =  as.numeric((Topt_upper - ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Upper) <0)
  dangerdays_upper = aggregate(ModeledTemps$danger_upper, list(ModeledTemps$DAY), sum)$x

  # Number of consecutive days in thermal danger without behavior

  # Length of longest streak above Topt (in hours)
  runs_point = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Point > Topt_point)
  runs_lower = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Lower > Topt_lower)
  runs_upper = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_Upper > Topt_upper)

  runs_NoB_point = rle(ModeledTemps$Mosq_Temp_NoB_Point > Topt_point)
